name: aws_sso_login
title: Start SSO login
description: Starts AWS SSO device authorization and returns the verification URL and code immediately. It does not wait for completion, so check with aws_sso_login_status after the user approves

profile.description: AWS profile name. If omitted, the awscli default resolution applies

state.description: State of the device authorization. Returned on success and on failed / timed-out

verificationUrl.description: URL to open in a browser to approve (success only, once awscli has printed it)

verificationUrlComplete.description: URL with the code filled in; no code entry is needed (success only, once awscli has printed it)

userCode.description: Code to enter at verificationUrl (success only, once awscli has printed it)

profile.description: Profile being authenticated. Empty when the awscli default resolution applies. Returned on success and on failed / timed-out

kind.description: Failure kind (failure only): not-allowed / invalid-input = rejected before running, timeout, awscli-missing, and the awscli failure kinds

detail.description: Full text of the failure and how to recover (failure only)

log.description: Redacted awscli output, only the beginning when it exceeds the limit (failure only)

warnings.description: Warnings raised during the run, such as top-level keys of the awscli JSON output that the tool does not declare and dropped (omitted when there are none)
